newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil judge may still rule today on CVRD appeal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil judge may still rule today on CVRD appeal.

text.p: A Brazilian judge considering a crucial government appeal on the privatization of mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) said he might still rule on Wednesday.

"It's possible it (my decision) could still come today," Justice Democrito Ramos Reinaldo of the Superior Court of Justice (STJ) said in Brasilia. Otherwise, he added, it would have to wait till Friday because of Thursday's public holiday.
The judge was studying a government petition that a host of injunctions against the sale of CVRD be considered by a single court because of a "conflict of interpretation".
Reinaldo said his options were to ask for more information from the government, reject the case, or accept it.
If he accepted it, he could either automatically overrule all existing injunctions against the CVRD sale or simply apply his decision to future injunctions.
The auction of 45 percent of CVRD's voting shares, due to begin Tuesday, was put on hold after a series of injunctions.
Justice Reinaldo said that if he ruled in favour of the government, overturning all previous injunctions, "the auction would be able to take place".
But he warned that a future ruling on the merit of the government's case as a whole could reverse the privatization.
